name: Meadows Mall
summary: Plaza with well-known department stores anchoring clothing, home goods, beauty, tech & toy shops.
demographics: Meadows Mall primarily serves middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers in the northwest Las Vegas area, attracting a diverse demographic mix that reflects the city's multicultural population. The trade area consists of established residential neighborhoods with households seeking convenient, everyday shopping options along with tourists looking for accessible retail experiences away from the Las Vegas Strip. Typical visitors include families with children who appreciate the mall's play area and practical tenant mix, as well as budget-conscious shoppers drawn to mid-market retailers and promotional events.
description: Meadows Mall is a premier shopping destination located in Las Vegas, Nevada, at 4300 Meadows Lane, offering families and visitors a complete retail experience in the heart of the city. The enclosed regional mall features a diverse mix of stores and restaurants, along with family-friendly amenities including a children's play area that makes it an ideal destination for shoppers of all ages. Conveniently positioned near popular Las Vegas attractions like the Springs Preserve and the Nevada State Museum, Meadows Mall serves as both a local shopping hub and a tourist destination. The mall operates with extended hours throughout the week, typically from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, with special extended holiday hours during the peak shopping season. Managed by Brookfield Properties, a leading retail real estate company, Meadows Mall continues to provide the Las Vegas community with quality shopping, dining, and entertainment options, while offering seasonal events and experiences such as photos with Santa during the holidays.
